name: Cloudflare
how_to_set: Free plan: limits are hard (requests fail above the daily quota).
Paid: Manage Account > Billing > Billable Usage > Budget alerts (or Notifications > Add > Budget Alert) at your amount.
Deploy the KV kill-switch snippet from infra/budgets/cloudflare so you can stop traffic with one command.
kill_switch: A KV flag checked by the Worker returns 503 when set: wrangler kv key put --binding=FK_FLAGS KILL on.
traps: Paid plan has no automatic pause; overage bills
Budget alerts are on projected spend and can arrive late
Durable Objects duration and R2 Class A operations
Workers $5/month minimum on the paid plan
unverified: No official statement found that a paid-plan hard spending cap does not exist
